title: Teno Yuki — Court of Heaven's Snow
revision: Draft 3 / Ice classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 wording pass; values unchanged)

classification.selector: jutsu classification: the qualifying element(s), whatever the jutsu's source
classification.applies_to: matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu
not_selectors: equipment / required bloodline item (castability gate only)
classification.off_kit_coverage: unverified (no non-bloodline jutsu catalog with effect rows in the repository)

emphasis.primary: Control by identity (Increase Damage Taken 35% on Ice Palace's circle; Decrease Damage Given 30% on Ice Coffin)
emphasis.secondary: Burst offense, the broadest coverage and heaviest route (Damage on three Ice rows at 45/40/40; Increase Damage Given 35% on Frostbound Ascendancy)
emphasis.tertiary: Self preservation (Decrease Damage Taken 35% and Heal 25 on Cryostorm Aegis)
emphasis.rationale: Teno Yuki is an A-rank Genjutsu bloodline with the Control and Defensive traits, and its supported rows split the same way: two enemy debuffs on 60 AP attack casts (Ice Palace exposure, Ice Coffin suppression), three Ice Damage rows at 45/40/40 (Imperial Freeze, Ice Coffin, Ice Palace) under an Increase Damage Given passive of 25% + 0.15 per user level, a single 35% self damage buff on Frostbound Ascendancy, and the kit's only guard and heal on the 40 AP Cryostorm Aegis. Control is primary by trait identity, not by weight: exposure and suppression are single rows that make the Genjutsu kit a pressure tool, while Damage is the broadest tag (three rows) and its route gives the strongest row-weighted build (Burst 23 against 19 for Exposure and Bulwark and 18 for Suppression). The Aegis rows are the tertiary sustain route; stun, absorb and recoil are unsupported and untouched. Potency reaches matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu (RUL-2026-10-03-005).

nodes.name: First Snow of Heaven
nodes.flavor: The first flakes settle without a sound; by morning the court belongs to winter.
nodes.coverage_note: Frostbound Ascendancy Increase Damage Given 35 → 37% (self); Ice Palace exposure 35 → 37% (enemies and allies inside the circle). Both live 2 rounds after cast.

nodes.name: Killing Frost
nodes.flavor: One cold night is enough. Nothing green survives it.
nodes.coverage_note: Imperial Freeze 45 → 47, Ice Coffin and Ice Palace 40 → 42 EP (Ice, Genjutsu-scaled, 60 AP). Palace's row hits allies in the circle.

nodes.name: Reign of Absolute Zero
nodes.flavor: At the bottom of the cold nothing moves, nothing resists, nothing is spared.
nodes.coverage_note: Burst: Imperial Freeze 45 → 50, Ice Coffin and Ice Palace 40 → 45 EP on the full route (+5 Damage).

nodes.name: Hairline Fracture
nodes.flavor: Every surface the frost touches is already fractured; it only waits for the blow.
nodes.coverage_note: Ice Palace exposure 37 → 40% with First Snow of Heaven (one area row, 2 rounds, 60 AP, cooldown 7); the kit's only exposure row.

nodes.name: Court of Splintered Ice
nodes.flavor: The palace shatters around the condemned; every shard carries the sovereign's will.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure: Ice Palace 35 → 45% on the full route (+10%; Ice, Water, Wind and element-less hits); Frostbound Ascendancy buff 40% with First Snow of Heaven.

nodes.name: Vigil of Winter
nodes.flavor: The watch is kept in silence and frost; the gate does not open.
nodes.coverage_note: Cryostorm Aegis Decrease Damage Taken 35 → 37% (self, 40 AP, 2 rounds); Ice Coffin Decrease Damage Given 30 → 32% (single enemy, 60 AP, 2 rounds).

nodes.name: Permafrost Mantle
nodes.flavor: Ground that has not thawed in a thousand years does not give way to a blade.
nodes.coverage_note: Cryostorm Aegis Decrease Damage Taken 37 → 40% with Vigil of Winter (one self row, all four stat types, no element: every non-pierce hit taken).

nodes.name: Still Heart of Winter
nodes.flavor: Beneath the snow the heart slows, mends, and endures until the thaw that never comes.
nodes.coverage_note: Bulwark: Cryostorm Aegis 35 → 45% Decrease Damage Taken on the full route (+10%); its Heal 25 → 28 (250 → 280 HP per tick on the two following rounds), both on one 40 AP cast.

nodes.name: Cold Saps the Will
nodes.flavor: Numb hands, slow thoughts, a blow that lands without conviction.
nodes.coverage_note: Ice Coffin Decrease Damage Given 32 → 35% with Vigil of Winter (one single-target row, 2 rounds, 60 AP); the kit's only suppression row.

nodes.name: Silence of Falling Snow
nodes.flavor: Snow deadens every sound. The enemy's fury arrives as a whisper; you are already healing.
nodes.coverage_note: Suppression: Ice Coffin 30 → 40% Decrease Damage Given on the full route (+10%); Cryostorm Aegis Heal 25 → 27 (270 HP per tick, two ticks per cast).

examples.name: Reign of Absolute Zero Burst
examples.rationale: +5 Damage on all three Ice Damage rows (Imperial Freeze 45 → 50, Ice Coffin and Ice Palace 40 → 45 EP) with Frostbound Ascendancy's self buff and Ice Palace's exposure at 37%: open with Palace and Frostbound (100 AP); Freeze and Coffin in the two following rounds land on an exposed target with the buff live. Vigil of Winter is the fourth purchase for a 37% Aegis guard and 32% Coffin suppression; Hairline Fracture (Palace exposure 40%) is the all-offense alternative.

examples.name: Court of Splintered Ice Exposure
examples.rationale: Ice Palace exposes every enemy in its circle at 45% for the two rounds after the cast, multiplying each Ice, Water, Wind or element-less hit the caster or allies land on them by ×1.45; Frostbound Ascendancy's self buff at 40% compounds on the caster's own matching hits in its window (×1.40 × 1.45 ≈ ×2.03), and the bloodline passive multiplies last. Vigil of Winter is the fourth purchase for 37% guard and 32% suppression; Killing Frost (+2 Damage on three rows) is the offensive alternative.

examples.name: Still Heart of Winter Bulwark
examples.rationale: Cryostorm Aegis becomes a 45% guard against non-pierce hits and heals 280 HP per tick, both live the two rounds after one 40 AP cast. First Snow of Heaven is the fourth purchase so the kit keeps 37% exposure and a 37% self damage buff for the counterattack; Cold Saps the Will (Coffin suppression 35%) is the pure-defense alternative.

examples.name: Silence of Falling Snow Suppression
examples.rationale: Ice Coffin multiplies its target's matching non-pierce hits by ×0.60 in the two rounds after the cast, and the Aegis heal rises to 270 HP per tick, the Control trait's own build. First Snow of Heaven is the fourth purchase for 37% exposure and 37% self damage buff; Permafrost Mantle (Aegis guard 40%) is the alternative that puts suppression and guard in the same window.

design_notes: Node split: First Snow of Heaven (IDG + IDT) is the attack root, forking into Damage (Killing Frost → Reign of Absolute Zero, three Ice rows) and exposure (Hairline Fracture → Court of Splintered Ice, the Ice Palace row). Vigil of Winter (DDT + DDG) is the defensive root, forking into guard (Permafrost Mantle → Still Heart of Winter, both Aegis rows) and suppression (Cold Saps the Will → Silence of Falling Snow, the Coffin row). 2F/4H/4A; capstones 3 BP deep; any two cost 5-6 BP.

Calibration by coverage: Damage +2/+3 (max +5) on three rows matches Taiyo's three-row figure (15 row-weighted). Increase Damage Taken, Decrease Damage Taken and Decrease Damage Given are single rows at +2%/+3%/+5% = +10% (45/45/40%), Taiyo's single-row scale; Increase Damage Taken gets a full route as the only exposure row. Increase Damage Given is glue (+2% root, +3% capstone secondary; max 40%) because the passive (25% + 0.15 per user level, combat.ts 3062: 28.75% at user level 25, 40% at 100) already multiplies matching hits. Heal is a capstone secondary only (+3% on Still Heart of Winter, +2% on Silence of Falling Snow; at most 280 HP per tick).

Resolver reads (§3): Aegis DDT and Coffin DDG list all four stat types and no element, so the filter is not binding: they act on every element-less or stat-typed non-pierce hit the caster takes or the Coffined enemy deals. Ice Palace IDT and Frostbound IDG list Ice/None/Water/Wind, no stat types: they match Ice, Water, Wind and element-less hits, never pierce. IDT is target-side, raising such hits from caster or allies on the exposed enemy; Frostbound's SELF IDG raises only the caster's own hits.

Delivery: all five jutsu have cooldown 7; the attacks cost 60 AP, Cryostorm Aegis and Frostbound Ascendancy 40 AP. Percentage rows and Aegis heal ticks are live the two rounds after the cast round (§3b): Ice Palace's IDT never raises its own hit, Frostbound's IDG only later-round attacks. Frostbound's IDG row is target SELF, realized on the caster at cast whatever the spiral (actions.ts 980-1004). Ice Palace (AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN radius 1, OTHER_USER) lands both rows once on each living non-caster in the circle.

Fourth purchases: Burst takes Vigil of Winter (37% guard, 32% suppression) or Hairline Fracture (40% exposure); Exposure takes Vigil of Winter or Killing Frost (+2 Damage); Bulwark takes First Snow of Heaven (37% exposure and self buff) or Cold Saps the Will (35% suppression); Suppression takes First Snow of Heaven or Permafrost Mantle (40% guard). Strongest unadvertised allocation by row weight: Reign of Absolute Zero + Hairline Fracture (+5 Damage, 40% exposure, no guard).

Reference reuse: the flats copy Taiyo Kami nearly verbatim (same 2F/4H/4A frame; +2%/+2% Foundations, Damage +2 → +3, Decrease Damage Taken and Decrease Damage Given +3% → +5%, +3% capstone secondaries) because the kits share five of Taiyo's six tags at similar reach (three Damage rows, single-row exposure, guard and suppression). Departures: no Afterburn rows, so Increase Damage Taken takes Emberwake's slot as its own route (+3% → +5%, Increase Damage Given secondary); Heal replaces Increase Damage Given / Increase Damage Taken as the defensive capstones' secondary, so no tag crosses roots and all 14 allocations stay non-dominated.
risks: Classification: Ice is the single qualifying element; sharing it with other bloodlines (Blue Blade Eyes, Hyouga Yui and others) is expected (RUL-2026-10-03-005). 5 of 8 kit rows carry Ice; Aegis Decrease Damage Taken and Heal and Coffin Decrease Damage Given are element-less and need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver. Cryostorm Aegis carries no Ice row, so in-kit it qualifies only through an authored jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Ice coverage (NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN) is unverified.

Ally hazard: Ice Palace rows 0 (Damage) and 1 (IDT) are AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN, friendly fire none (= ALL): Killing Frost and Reign of Absolute Zero raise the hit on allies in the circle to 42/45, and the IDT nodes expose allies inside at up to 45%. The caster is never a target (OTHER_USER). Ice Coffin (single, none/ALL) reaches an ally only if aimed at one; Imperial Freeze's row is ENEMIES-only.

Exposure downstream: a 45% Ice Palace debuff multiplies every non-pierce Ice, Water, Wind or element-less hit the target takes by ×1.45 from caster or allies in the two rounds after cast, so its value scales with party damage and enemies in the circle. Same-tag debuffs from different casters all apply (process.ts 1109-1117): two Palaces compound to ×1.45 × 1.45 ≈ ×2.10. Flats held to Taiyo's single-row +10%.

Guard and suppression: Aegis DDT on the caster and Coffin DDG on the enemy, live in the same round, apply in sequence to the Coffined enemy's matching hits on the caster (100 AP cast together). Both routes cost 6 BP, so a build caps at ×0.55 × 0.65 ≈ ×0.36 (Still Heart of Winter + Cold Saps the Will, 45% and 35%) or ×0.60 × 0.60 = ×0.36 (Silence of Falling Snow + Permafrost Mantle, 40% and 40%), well above the 10% damage floor; the Water-only 15% DDT passive applies last.

Heal: Cryostorm Aegis heals 250 HP per tick at jutsu level 25 on the two rounds after cast; the route maxima add 30 HP (Still Heart of Winter, +3%) or 20 HP (Silence of Falling Snow, +2%) per tick, a small value against late-game pools, so Heal is only a capstone secondary; healprevent on the caster blocks it. Cooldown 7 allows one Aegis window per caster, and the row is SELF, so an ally's Aegis never lands on the caster.

Offense stacking: in Frostbound Ascendancy's window (two rounds after cast) a matching caster hit (Ice, Water, Wind or element-less: kit Damage rows, normal jutsu, weapons, basic attacks) is multiplied by ×1.40 at the +5% maximum, and by ×1.40 × 1.45 ≈ ×2.03 on an Ice Palace-exposed target; the bloodline passive multiplies last. Not simulated.

No adverse rows, hidden jutsu, item gates, mode restrictions or injected children exist. Stun (Imperial Freeze), absorb and recoil (Frostbound Ascendancy) are unsupported and unchanged; no pierce, lifesteal, reflect or afterburn rows. Ranked modes suppress skill-tree and bloodline effects. No combat simulation: non-dominance of the 14 allocations is arithmetic over per-row additions only.

Rank and shape: Teno Yuki is A-rank with an Increase Damage Given passive of 25% + 0.15 per user level (28.75% for a level-25 user, 40% at level 100; combat.ts 3062) and a 100 regen bonus. The tree equalises marginal opportunity against the Taiyo reference, not final strength. Cross-bloodline comparison (including the other Ice kits) is deferred to the roster review.

audit.revision: Draft 3 / Ice classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 wording pass; values unchanged)
limits: Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).

Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.
Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.
Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.
